instructions: You are a warm, friendly female guide with a clear standard British English accent. Speak gently and naturally to a five-year-old, with a smile in your voice. Use a relaxed, easy-to-follow pace and short pauses between sentences. Be encouraging without a baby voice. Pronounce Zach as Zak. Read only the supplied words, exactly as written. No extra introduction, music or sound effects.

hello.text: Hi Zach! Let’s make some music. Tap Play. The light goes round and round.

stop.text: Hear that beat? The light moves as it plays. Tap Stop.

drum.text: Tap this drum. Give it a go!

beat.text: Tap this box. A lit box makes a beat. A dark box is a rest.

tunes.text: Let’s make a tune. Tap Tunes.

note.text: Tap this box. Notes at the top sound high. Notes at the base sound low.

chord.text: Add one more note in the same stack. They play at once. That is a chord!

sounds.text: Try a new sound. Tap Sounds.

slide.text: Slide this. The shape and the sound change. Try soft, then bright.

done.text: You made music! Have fun, Zach.
